description: Implementation of the Bbr2Sender class for congestion control in QUIC, including mode dispatching, congestion window management, pacing, and state debugging.

classes.name: Bbr2Sender
classes.description: Implements the BBRv2 congestion control algorithm for QUIC, managing modes, congestion window, pacing, and state debugging.

methods.name: Bbr2Sender
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Bbr2Sender with network parameters, congestion window, pacing, and mode states.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures Bbr2Sender parameters based on QuicConfig options.

methods.name: ApplyConnectionOptions
methods.description: Applies connection options based on provided connection tags.

methods.name: GetCwndLimitsByMode
methods.description: Returns congestion window limits based on current mode.

methods.name: cwnd_limits
methods.description: Returns current congestion window limits.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts congestion control parameters based on network conditions.

methods.name: SetInitialCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets initial congestion window in packets during startup mode.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, updates mode, pacing, and congestion window.

methods.name: UpdatePacingRate
methods.description: Updates the pacing rate based on bandwidth estimates and current state.

methods.name: UpdateCongestionWindow
methods.description: Adjusts the congestion window based on bandwidth and network conditions.

methods.name: GetTargetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Calculates target congestion window based on bandwidth-delay product and gain.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is sent, including updating stats and possibly entering quiescence.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Handles packet neutering events.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if data can be sent based on current congestion window.

methods.name: GetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns current congestion window size.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns current pacing rate.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles application-limited state.

methods.name: GetTargetBytesInflight
methods.description: Returns target bytes in flight based on BDP and congestion window.

methods.name: PopulateConnectionStats
methods.description: Populates connection statistics.

methods.name: OnEnterQuiescence
methods.description: Marks the start of quiescence period.

methods.name: OnExitQuiescence
methods.description: Handles exit from quiescence, possibly changing mode.

methods.name: GetDebugState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current debug state.

methods.name: ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports the current debug state as a structured object.
